normal.name: The Boss Rush Network
normal.text: What happens when the games we love disappear forever? 🎮 In this clip from the Boss Rush Podcast, Corey Dirrig, LeRon Dawkins, and Andre Wilson explore the growing fight to preserve video game history as digital storefronts close, licenses expire, and online servers shut down. Should publishers control access to older games, or should players have a way to keep these experiences alive for future generations? #BossRushPodcast #GamePreservation #RetroGaming #GamingNews #VideoGames

normal.name: Followerspanda
normal.text: Asmongold was Twitch's most-watched streamer in September 2026. He pulled nearly 10 million hours watched, up 189% from August, riding long World of Warcraft sessions during the game's resurgence. Lesson for creators: when your main game gets a big moment, go all in and stream it consistently. normal.name: Jordan (Temporarily Spooky)
normal.text: I restored a "Double Dragon" (1987) arcade cabinet about 20 years ago. There's a glitch where if you're able to get the box from Mission 2 into Mission 3, it changes colors from tan to purple because of a color palette change. My family and I have been seeing how far we can get the box. It's hard because for some reason the enemies go after it like it's filled with money! We've resorted to one player carrying the box, and the other guarding him. #arcade #doubledragon #retrogaming #videogames

normal.name: Eli K.P. William
normal.text: For over two years I’ve been working on a video game as a writer and story consultant. Yesterday I visited the development studio to try a beta version of the game. It's come a long way since the last time I tried it; the cutscenes are intense and the gameplay is something special. Overall lots of fun to play. #videogame #writing
